payload.question_text: Which AI methods can the service combine for analysis? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: OCR reads printed text from images. The service can combine it with other methods.

options.error_type: Confuses manual processing with AI methods
options.rationale: Manual entry is performed by people rather than an AI method. The workflow aims to reduce such manual work.
options.better_fit: This fits cases where a person must type information by hand.

options.rationale: Speech recognition analyzes spoken audio. The service can combine it with other methods.
Natural language understanding helps analyze linguistic meaning. The service can combine it with other methods.

payload.explanation: Correct. OCR, speech recognition, and natural language understanding can be combined.

payload.question_text: Which assets can AI-powered information extraction unlock information from? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Printed text is not the only supported source. Audio and video can also provide useful information.
options.better_fit: This fits basic OCR when image text is the sole source.

options.rationale: Documents are business assets that can contain extractable information. They are within the scope of AI-powered extraction.
Recordings can contain useful spoken business information. AI-powered extraction can unlock information from audio.
Video can contain information that organizations need. AI-powered extraction can work across video assets.

payload.explanation: Correct. The approach can unlock information from several asset types.

payload.question_text: A travel-office planner must estimate visitor volumes at tourist locations. Which inputs should the planner analyze? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Photos provide visual evidence of people at a location. They can support visitor-volume estimates.
Video shows activity at tourist locations over time. It can support visitor-volume estimates.
Location images show visual information relevant to visitor counts. They fit the planner's goal.

options.error_type: Confuses visitor analysis with support analysis
options.rationale: Support calls reveal problems and resolutions rather than visible visitor numbers. They do not supply visual evidence for this decision.
options.better_fit: This fits identifying recurring customer-support issues and resolutions.

feedback.intrinsic: The planner would have no visual evidence for estimating visitor volumes.
feedback.instructional: Use images and video when estimating visitor volumes.

payload.explanation: Correct. Images and video fit visitor-volume estimation.

payload.question_text: A records manager needs invoice results that another system can store and search. Which output should the manager request?

options.rationale: Structured JSON organizes invoice values into machine-readable fields. Another system can store and search those fields.
Video is unstructured content that may be analyzed. It is not organized invoice output for another system.
options.better_fit: This fits source material for analyzing recorded visual content.

feedback.intrinsic: The manager would still lack searchable invoice fields.
feedback.instructional: Request structured output rather than original unstructured content.

options.rationale: Image text may contain invoice words without organizing them into fields. The manager needs data suitable for storage and search.
options.better_fit: This fits a task requiring only recognized printed text.

feedback.intrinsic: Invoice numbers and totals could still require manual sorting.
feedback.instructional: Choose structured data when another system needs usable fields.

options.rationale: A call recording is unstructured audio input. It does not provide organized invoice fields.
options.better_fit: This fits input for analyzing a recorded support call.

feedback.intrinsic: No invoice data would be ready for the records system.
feedback.instructional: Select output organized into fields for downstream use.

payload.explanation: Correct. Structured JSON is suitable for storage and search.

options.better_fit: This fits a need limited to reading printed text in an image.

feedback.intrinsic: The analyst may receive text but not the full structured result.
feedback.instructional: The question asks for the workflow outcome after analysis.

options.better_fit: This fits checking the status of a still-running programmatic request.

feedback.intrinsic: The analyst would keep waiting instead of receiving the completed result.
feedback.instructional: Once analysis is complete, return structured output that follows the model.

options.rationale: After analysis, the workflow returns structured output matching the model. This gives the analyst the requested invoice result.

options.rationale: Contracts are unstructured documents that can contain extractable fields. This job fits structured extraction.
Recorded calls can contain information that needs organizing. This job fits the service's ability to analyze unstructured content.
Reading image text only is narrower than the manager's cross-content needs. The stated work involves contracts, calls, and meetings.
options.better_fit: This fits a single image where only printed text is needed.

feedback.intrinsic: The calls and meetings would not be addressed.
feedback.instructional: Choose the broader structured-extraction capability for these content types.

options.rationale: Recorded meetings are video content with extractable details. This job fits the service's structured extraction capability.

payload.explanation: Correct. Each selected job extracts information from unstructured content.

payload.question_text: A finance clerk receives many scanned receipts and must reduce manual entry of descriptions and amounts. Which approach should the clerk choose?

options.error_type: Confuses broad extraction with text recognition
options.rationale: Basic OCR reads text but may not identify the needed receipt fields. The clerk needs relevant details extracted for use.
options.better_fit: This fits when editable printed text is the only required result.

feedback.intrinsic: The clerk may still need to identify descriptions and amounts manually.
feedback.instructional: Receipt processing needs extracted details, not only recognized text.

options.rationale: This approach extracts relevant receipt details while reducing manual effort. It fits the clerk's stated goal.

options.better_fit: This fits converting a recorded call into written words.

feedback.intrinsic: No speech is present to transcribe from the receipt.
feedback.instructional: Match the method to the content type being processed.

options.rationale: Manual entry can record values but does not reduce manual work. The scenario specifically requires reducing that work.
options.better_fit: This fits cases where information must be entered by a person.

feedback.intrinsic: The clerk would continue typing every receipt detail.
feedback.instructional: Use extraction when the goal is to reduce hand entry.
